shots.say: A mechanical finding names its path. The cheap model fixes only that. The director opens every sheet.
One command. Held frames are captured once. Redraw one shot, or a range. Or inspect one frame.

shots.title: What the command does
shots.say: The spec is validated. A local browser draws and reviews it, and writes the sheets. Then ffmpeg encodes the video.

shots.title: how-it-works.json, its first lines
shots.say: The voice is made here, with Kokoro. Add a bed, cues and captions.

shots.caption: One shot, six looks
shots.say: The same shot, in six looks.
And vertical shorts, for Reels, TikTok and Shorts.
It runs on *your machine*. At render time, only the voice model is downloaded, once. It is MIT, so what it makes is yours.
HyperFrames takes HTML, Remotion takes React: open code an agent can break. make-motion takes a closed JSON spec.
MIT, with no seat or revenue limit, unlike Remotion's company licence.
